sharedPrompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset: one standalone Tristana seasonal journal header. Generate a single landscape 1536x1024 image, aspect 3:2. Match the original approved June Oregon coast illustrations: detailed realistic painted landscape, refined restrained watercolor washes with very fine natural textures and believable atmospheric depth. Keep detailed rock, foliage, water and architecture rendering through the gradual fade; do NOT turn edges into abstract watercolor splotches or coarse brush dabs. Compose the main scene on the right two-thirds; leave the leftmost 25–35% mostly blank for journal text. Scene gently dissolves into the CORRECT JUNE BACKGROUND, a pale COOL BLUE-WHITE HEX #F5FAFB (RGB 245,250,251). Opaque theme-matched image, NOT transparent. No warm cream or yellow tint in blank paper, even when scene has golden sunset light. A broad, softly irregular curved/diagonal fade runs from upper-left towards bottom-right, follows the landscape's forms, and fades across the bottom edge. Preserve detailed imagery near bottom-right before the final soft lower-edge fade. Top/right scene edges are sharp, fully illustrated to edges; no frame, no abrupt rectangular cutoffs, no separate border, no white rectangle. Subtle fine paper texture only. Season: June early summer on the Pacific coast, fresh coastal greenery, no snow, autumn leaves or tropical vegetation. No text, typography, watermark, panels, collage, large foreground people or dense crowds. Light and geography feel natural rather than fantasy. Scene:
